'''Razell Tameron''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] who served as a member of the [[Bespin Wing Guard/Legends|Bespin Wing Guard]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He worked as warden of the Wing Guards' base of operations in [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]], the [[Cloud City Security Tower]]. After the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] arrived on Bespin seeking to capture a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] headed for the planet, Tameron was amongst the Wing Guard who helped the Rebels escape Imperial clutches after they had been captured.

==Biography==
Born on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]], the [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] Razell Tameron came to serve with the [[Bespin Wing Guard/Legends|Bespin Wing Guard]] by the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. During the war he held the role of [[Warden/Legends|Warden]] of the [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] [[Cloud City Security Tower|Security Tower]],<ref name="SWI" /> the Wing Guards' base of operations<ref name="TJoY">''[[The Jewel of Yavin]]''</ref> and detention center on Bespin.<ref name="ESB" /> In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Imperial forces lead by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] arrived on Cloud [[City/Legends|City]], where they made a deal with the [[Baron Administrator/Legends|Baron Administrator]] [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] that the city could remain free and neutral if it aided the Empire in capturing a group of Rebels who were headed for Bespin. The Rebels were successfully captured after arriving, but after Vader changed the deal he and the Baron Administrator had made, Calrissian changed his mind and turned against the Empire.<ref name="ESB" />

Calrissian secretly contacted his Chief administrative aide [[Lobot/Legends|Lobot]], sending him the message "Code Force Seven",<ref name="EGtC">''[[The Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> which signalled the aide to gather a group of a dozen<ref name="ESBn">[[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode V: The Empire Strikes Back'']]</ref> Wing guardsmen including Tameron, [[Corman Jeihn]], [[Pedar Solardo/Legends|Pedar Solardo]], [[Gir Endac]], [[Bialar Selis]], and [[Helder Spinoza/Legends|Helder Spinoza]].<ref name="SWI" /> The guardsmen proceeded to ambush an Imperial unit led by [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Sheckil/Legends|Sheckil]], who were traveling with Calrissian and transporting three of the captured Rebels to Vader's [[ST 321/Legends|personal shuttle]]. The Imperials were taken captive by the Wing guard and escorted to the Security Tower, while the prisoners, [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], were freed and left with Calrissian to escape. The Rebels and Calrissian managed to successfully escape Cloud City, which was left under [[Occupation of Bespin|Imperial control]].<ref name="ESB" />

==Personality and traits==
Razell Tameron had dark skin and [[Color/Legends|black]] hair.<ref name="ESB" /> He was known for his no-nonsense attitude towards crime in Cloud City<ref name="SWI" /> and was not involved in the corruption that had grown within the Wing Guards under former Baron Administrator [[Dominic Raynor]].<ref name="FB">{{Facebook|username=star-wars-sourcebooks|url=notes/star-wars-sourcebooks/naming-the-cloud-city-wing-guards/714850175231759|name=Star Wars Sourcebooks|date=2014-03-06}}</ref>

==Equipment==
While working as a winguard, Tameron wore the blue uniform worn by guardsmen in the organization, and carried a [[Relby-k23 blaster pistol]].<ref name="ESB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Razell Tameron first appeared in [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']], in which he went unnamed and was portrayed by an uncredited extra.<ref name="ESB" /> A [[Star Wars Manga: The Empire Strikes Back|manga]] adaptation of Episode V was released in [[1999]] by [[Dark Horse Comics]] which included Tameron's scene in its [[Star Wars Manga: The Empire Strikes Back 4|fourth]] issue. The comic depicts eight of the twelve guards involved in the ambush, but it is not clear if Tameron is one of those shown.<ref name="ESBm">[[Star Wars Manga: The Empire Strikes Back 4|''Star Wars Manga: The Empire Strikes Back'' 4]]</ref> The character was later named and given some backstory in [[2014]] along with a number of other Wing Guards in the [[Rogues Gallery (department)|''Rogues Gallery'']] feature of [[Star Wars Insider 148|''Star Wars Insider'' 148]]. The article was written by [[Tim Veekhoven]], [[Kevin Beentjes]] and [[Sander de Lange]],<ref name="SWI" /> who later said in a Facebook post that they had wanted to give some Wing guards specializations, including Tameron's role as warden. In the Facebook post they also stated that all of the Wing Guards in the article who had not previously been established as corrupt were not corrupt, and most were "good guys" who opposed the corruption.<ref name="FB" />
